title: TLS as Predictors and Targets in Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy for NSCLC.
snippet: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) have emerged as critical modulators of antitumor immunity in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with growing evidence supporting their role as both prognostic biomarkers and functional targets in neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. title: An Open Source Automated Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes Algorithm for Prognosis in Primary Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma Using Routine Hematoxylin and Eosin Stained Sections.
snippet: While tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) are prognostic in various cancers, their role in small bowel adenocarcinoma (SBA) is unexplored. This study evaluates the prognostic significance of digitally quantified TILs in SBA.
